name: channel_a_lapsed_lease_reopens_it
description: The lease is what makes a crashed producer release the channel without anyone noticing it crashed. Nothing sends a release when a laptop's battery dies, so a channel held without a deadline is held forever and the room's audio never comes back.

steps.description: one microsecond before the lease ends it is still held
at the deadline it lapses, and the lapsed owner is named so a shell can log which producer went away
and a far lower priority can now take it, because it is free rather than outranked
